summary: The ad tells the story of Rahul, a domestic call center worker earning 12,000 rupees who gets rejected from international call center jobs due to poor English. His friend recommends the English Seekho app, which offers a 1-rupee trial and 15-minute daily practice with an AI coach. After practicing for a month, Rahul successfully passes his interview and lands a job paying 35,000 rupees, prompting viewers to install the app.
